results.title: WAHO urges ECOWAS to strengthen its health workforce
results.description: The West African Health Organization (WAHO) has called on ECOWAS member states to strengthen its health workforce, improve training, distribution and retention of professionals to address shortages and ensure quality healthcare delivery across the region. WAHO Director-General, Prof. Palokinam Pitche, made the call in Abuja on Monday during the 11th Statutory Meeting of the Regional […] The post WAHO urges ECOWAS to strengthen its health workforce first appeared on QUICK NEWS AFRICA.
